pdf_title: Chart-8.4 PERCENTAGE DISTRIBUTION OF DACOITY CASES REPORTED DURING 1998 (BY PLACE OF OCCURRENCE) Robbery 8.8.1 Table 41 represents the State, UT and city-wise information on the number of cases reported and the value of property robbed at various `Places of Occurrence' in the country during 1998. 47.6% of the total cases of Robbery were reported at Other Places. 41.1 per cent of the property loss (by value) in the country was also reported at `Other Places'. Out of 1207 cases of Robbery at `Commercial Establishments', Bihar reported 184 such cases with a property loss of Rs. 151.8 lakhs, followed by Maharashtra, 170 cases with a property loss of Rs. 285.5 lakhs. Maharashtra reported the highest number (85) of Robberies at `Railways' which accounted for 21.9 per cent of the total Robberies at Railways. Out of 62 cases of Bank robberies in the country, as many as 21 were reported in Bihar, followed by Uttar Pradesh with 15 cases. Together, these two States accounted for 58.1 per cent of the total cases and 40.9 per cent of the total value lost in Bank robberies reported in the country. The highest incidents of robbery at `Residential Premises' were recorded in the Metropolitan city of Delhi (297) and `Commercial Establishments' at Madurai (76). `Highway' robberies were more in Kanpur (216) and Patna (201). All 13 cases of robberies under `Railways' were reported from Delhi.
